title: Adversarial Stress Tests for Quantum Certification
summary: We develop a practical framework for semi-device-independent (SDI) certification under operational deviations from the ideal protocol model. Apparent violations of classical benchmarks need not signal genuinely non-classical behaviour; they can arise from misalignment between (i) the scoring rule, (ii) the finite-sample statistical bound applied to that score, and (iii) the operational model realised in the experiment, including bias, memory, drift, and selection effects.
